title: BNY Extends Reach Into Tokenized Funds and Pay-to-Wallet Service
message_html: BNY Extends Reach Into Tokenized Funds and Pay-to-Wallet Service ...
snippet: Having shifted to a platform operating model over the past few years, BNY is now realizing the benefits of new model by having its teams come together to develop more integrated and innovative solutions for clients, BNY CEO Robin Vince said Thursday (Oct. 15) during the bank’s third quarter earnings
